On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
O1=G['Demo pair 1 output']; O2=G['Demo pair 2 output']
for name,O in [('d1',O1),('d2',O2)]:
    I=G[name+' input']
    cnt=Counter(x for r in I for x in r)
    dom=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rare=[v for v,c in cnt.items() if v!=0 and c<=2]
    print(name,'rare colors',rare)
    best=[]
    for i in range(5):
        for j in range(5):
            win=[I[i+a][j+b] for a in range(3) for b in range(3)]
            rr=sum(1 for x in win if x in rare)
            best.append((rr,i,j))
    best.sort(reverse=True)
    print('  max rare in window:',best[:3])

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
feats={}
for n in range(1,8):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    cnt=Counter(x for r_ in I for x in r_)
    otype = 'bar' if sum(O[0])==0 and all(c==8 for c in O[1]) else ('T' if O[0][1]==8 and O[2][1]==8 else 'hook')
    # also detect: bar if middle row full
    feat={
      'ndistinct': len(cnt),
      'numzeros': cnt[0],
      'numones': cnt.get(1,0),
      'domcount': cnt.most_common(1)[0][1],
      'cntodd_colors': sum(1 for v,c in cnt.items() if c%2==1),
      'cnteven_colors': sum(1 for v,c in cnt.items() if c%2==0 and c>0),
      'maxcnt': max(cnt.values()),
      'has8': 1 if 8 in cnt else 0,
      'mincnt_nonzero': min(v for v in cnt.values() if v),
      'sum': sum(cnt.values()),
    }
    feats[n]=(otype,feat)
for k,v in feats.items(): print(k,v)
